name: kuberay
description: Kubernetes-native operator for managing RayCluster, RayJob, and RayService resources on NKP.
overview:
**Overview**

KubeRay Operator installs and manages the Ray control plane on Kubernetes. It provides CRDs
and controllers for `RayCluster`, `RayJob`, and `RayService`, enabling declarative lifecycle
management for distributed Ray workloads on NKP.

**Key capabilities**

- Declarative Ray lifecycle management through Kubernetes CRDs
- Native support for Ray jobs, services, and autoscaling workflows
- Production-ready reconciliation with retries via Flux and Helm
- Namespace-isolated deployment in the `kuberay` namespace

**Resources**

[Documentation](https://docs.ray.io/en/latest/cluster/kubernetes/index.html) · [Project](https://github.com/ray-project/kuberay)
